title: TOEIC リーディング 難問セット

questions.q: The CEO insisted that the merger ------- announced until all regulatory approvals had been secured.
questions.why: insist などの要求・主張を表す動詞に続く that 節では、動詞は原形（should を省略した仮定法現在）。否定は not be となる。

questions.q: ------- the proposal's merits, the board remained reluctant to commit additional funds.
questions.why: 後ろが名詞句なので前置詞が必要。Notwithstanding は「～にもかかわらず」の前置詞。Whereas と Whether は接続詞、Moreover は副詞。

questions.q: The committee will consider only those proposals, the details of ------- are submitted in writing.
questions.why: the details of ------- は前置詞＋関係代名詞の形。先行詞は proposals（物）なので of which。

questions.q: Ms. Park is widely regarded as ------- of the most innovative designers in the industry.
questions.why: of the most ～ の最上級の前は one of the ～ s（最も～な者の一人）が定型。

questions.q: Had the supplier delivered the parts on time, the factory ------- its quarterly target.
questions.why: Had ＋ 主語 ＋ 過去分詞は If ～ had done の倒置で、過去の事実に反する仮定。主節は would have ＋ 過去分詞。

questions.q: The new regulations are intended to ------- compliance without placing undue burden on small businesses.
questions.why: ensure は「確実にする」。assure と reassure は人を目的語に取り、insure は保険を掛ける意味。

questions.q: The auditor found that several expense reports had been ------- altered to conceal duplicate claims.
questions.why: had been と過去分詞 altered の間で動詞を修飾するのは副詞。

questions.q: Ms. Gomez's presentation was so ------- that the client signed the contract on the spot.
questions.why: so ＋ 形容詞 ＋ that ～ の形。主語は発表（物）なので、「説得力のある」persuasive が入る。persuaded は人が主語のとき。

questions.q: Neither the project manager nor the team members ------- aware of the revised deadline until Friday.
questions.why: neither ～ nor ～ では動詞は後ろ側の名詞に一致させる。後ろは複数の team members で、過去の文脈なので were。

questions.q: The firm has yet ------- a decision on whether to relocate its headquarters.
questions.why: have yet to do で「まだ～していない」という定型表現。

questions.q: Management remains ------- to the idea of allowing staff to work remotely full time.
questions.why: remain の補語になり、前置詞 to を伴う形容詞は resistant（～に抵抗する）。

questions.q: Sales of the new model were ------- higher than the company's most optimistic projections.
questions.why: 形容詞 higher を修飾するのは副詞 considerably。
助動詞 must の後ろは動詞の原形。主語の Employees が提出する側なので能動態。

c: The new accounting software was introduced last spring.
Employees who travel frequently may request a company credit card.
This deadline will be strictly enforced.
Please note that the 14-day period begins on the date each receipt is issued.
questions.why: 次の文の「この期間（window）を過ぎた請求」を受けるには、直前に期限の話が必要。期限の厳守を述べる文がつながる。最後の誤答は、帰着後14日という本文と食い違う。
or でつながれた名詞 upgrades を修飾する過去分詞（形容詞）。事前承認がない限り対象外という流れに合う。
費用が18％増えたことを受け、費用を「抑える」ための変更。curb が適切。
have ＋ 目的語 ＋ 形容詞（～の状態にしておく）の形。available が入る。
「8時までに準備を終える」という期限を表す by。
後ろに節があり、追加スタッフが必要なため追加料金がかかるという因果関係。Because of は名詞句が必要。

c: Otherwise, the ballroom will be available to you from 10 A.M. as originally booked.
The ballroom can accommodate up to 400 guests in a banquet layout.
A surcharge will also apply to catering orders placed after Friday.
The wedding will end at midnight.
questions.why: 「金曜までに回答してほしい」の後に、回答がなければ当初の10時からになる、という Otherwise の文が論理的につながる。

questions.q: What is suggested about Line 3's result?
c: It was the best result in the plant.
It may not reflect normal operating conditions.
It was caused by the new supplier.
questions.why: 9日間停止していたため、改善の証拠とは見なせないと述べている。通常の稼働状況を反映していない可能性がある。

questions.q: What does Ms. Sato imply about the new coating supplier?
c: Its lower price may not lead to overall savings.
Its products are more expensive than expected.
questions.why: 価格は12％安いが、手直しの費用で相殺されていると疑っている。

questions.q: By how many defective units per 1,000 did the rate on Line 2 increase?
What are supervisors asked to do by September 30?
c: Report anything unusual found in the incident logs
questions.why: 期間中の事故記録を確認し、異常があれば9月30日までに報告するよう求めている。

questions.q: What is indicated in the letter about the bonus?
c: It is paid together with the monthly salary.
It becomes available only after a full year of work.
questions.why: 賞与は最初の丸1年が経過した後に対象となると書かれている。

questions.q: Why does Mr. Okonkwo ask to change the start date?
c: He wants to attend a family event.
He has not received the acceptance form.
His current employer needs him until after the planned date.
The reference checks are not finished.
questions.why: 現在の会社が1月15日まで勤務を求めており、1月11日の開始に間に合わない。

questions.q: How much more relocation assistance does Mr. Okonkwo request than the amount offered?
questions.why: 希望は6,500ドル、提示は4,000ドルなので差は2,500ドル。

questions.q: What is implied about Mr. Okonkwo's acceptance?
c: It depends on certain changes being approved.
It was sent after the offer expired.
It was approved by his employer.
questions.why: 「受諾はするが」条件の変更が認められれば署名済みの書類を返す、という条件付きの受諾。

questions.q: How many days before the offer's expiration date did Mr. Okonkwo send his e-mail?
questions.why: メールは11月30日、期限は12月4日なので4日前。

questions.q: According to the Web page, what must selected speakers pay for themselves?
questions.why: 登録料は無料で、旅費と宿泊費は自己負担と書かれている。

questions.q: When did Ms. Voss submit her proposal relative to the deadline?
c: On the day of the deadline
questions.why: 提出は10月30日で、締め切りは10月31日。

questions.q: Why was Ms. Voss concerned about her proposal?
c: It was submitted to the wrong office.
Part of it had been presented at another event.
questions.why: 事例の旧版が過去に別の会議で発表されており、応募資格を失う恐れがあると考えた。

questions.q: What does Mr. Silva ask Ms. Voss to do?
c: Submit a revised summary describing what is new
Present at the Bruntal Logistics Forum
questions.why: 新しいデータの内容を説明した300語の改訂版を11月7日までに出すよう求めている。

questions.q: By when will Ms. Voss most likely be told the result of her proposal?
questions.why: 通知は12月15日までに送られると、募集ページに書かれている。

MEMO - Revised Travel Expense Policy

Effective January 1, all travel expenses will be reimbursed under a revised policy. Employees (1) receipts within 14 days of returning from a trip. (2) Claims submitted after this window will be processed only with written approval from a department head. The company will no longer cover alcohol, in-room entertainment, or (3) upgrades to first-class travel unless approved in advance. These changes are intended to (4) costs, which rose 18 percent last year.

docs.label: E-mail
docs.text:
From: Hiroko Sato, Quality Manager
To: Plant Supervisors
Date: September 22
Subject: Third-quarter defect report

Defective units per 1,000 produced:
            Q2     Q3
Line 1      6.2    5.8
Line 2      4.1    7.5
Line 3      5.0    4.9

As you can see, Line 2 is the only line whose rate worsened, which coincided with the introduction of the new coating supplier on July 15. Although the supplier's price is 12 percent lower, I suspect that the savings are being offset by rework costs. Before deciding whether to revert to the previous supplier, I would like each supervisor to review the incident logs for the period and report anything unusual by September 30. Please note that Line 3's result should not be regarded as evidence of improvement, since the line was shut down for nine days for maintenance.

docs.label: Letter
docs.text:
Halvorsen Capital
November 20

Dear Mr. Okonkwo,

We are pleased to offer you the position of Senior Analyst. Your annual salary will be $82,000, paid monthly, with a start date of January 11. You will be eligible for a performance bonus of up to 10 percent of base salary after your first full year. Relocation assistance of up to $4,000 will be reimbursed upon submission of receipts within 60 days of your start date. This offer is contingent on satisfactory reference checks and expires on December 4. Please sign and return the enclosed acceptance form by that date.

Sincerely,
Dana Halvorsen, Director of Recruitment

docs.label: E-mail
docs.text:
From: Emeka Okonkwo
To: Dana Halvorsen
Date: November 30
Subject: Offer of employment

Dear Ms. Halvorsen,

Thank you for the offer. I am delighted to accept in principle. However, my move will cost more than the stated assistance because I am relocating with my family from overseas, and I estimate the total at $6,500. In addition, my current employer requires me to work through January 15. Would it be possible to raise the relocation assistance to $6,500 and move my start date to January 18? I would also appreciate confirmation of whether the bonus is prorated in the first year. If these adjustments are acceptable, I will return the signed form immediately.

Best regards,
Emeka Okonkwo

docs.label: Web page
docs.text:
GLOBAL SUPPLY CHAIN SUMMIT - Call for Presentation Proposals

The summit will be held March 18-20 in Lisbon. Proposals of 300 words must be submitted online by October 31. Selected speakers receive free registration (value: $450) but must cover their own travel and accommodation. Sessions are 30 minutes long, including 5 minutes for questions. Proposals focusing on case studies with measurable results will be given priority. Notifications will be sent by December 15. Presentations that have been given previously at other conferences are not eligible.

docs.label: E-mail
docs.text:
From: Karin Voss
To: Summit Program Office
Date: November 2
Subject: Proposal submitted October 30

Dear Program Committee,

I submitted a proposal on October 30 titled "Cutting Lead Times with Regional Hubs." I realize I did not mention that an earlier version of the case study was presented at the Bruntal Logistics Forum last year, and I am concerned that this might disqualify me. The material has since been updated with this year's data, including a 14 percent reduction in delivery times. Should I withdraw my proposal?

Best regards,
Karin Voss

docs.label: E-mail
docs.text:
From: Mateus Silva, Program Office
To: Karin Voss
Date: November 3
Subject: Re: Proposal submitted October 30

Dear Ms. Voss,

Thank you for your honesty. Previously presented material is ineligible only when it is presented substantially in its original form. Since your case study has been updated with new data, it will remain under consideration. However, please submit a revised 300-word summary by November 7 that explains what is new. If your proposal is accepted, you would be given a 30-minute slot, and we ask that speakers confirm their travel plans within two weeks of notification.

Kind regards,
Mateus Silva
